title: Chickens and cows heads/legs puzzle (hard)
prompt: A farmer has chickens and cows. Together they have 35 heads and 94 legs. How many cows does the farmer have? Explain your reasoning.

metadata.hard_reason: Classic two-variable simultaneous equations problem; real models sometimes mix up which animal has which leg coefficient.
metadata.notes: Narrowed from the original draft (which asked for both chickens AND cows) to ask for cows only, since exact_match can only cleanly verify a single value. c + k = 35 (heads), 2c + 4k = 94 (legs) -> k = 12 cows (and c = 23 chickens, not checked by this task).
